evidence.quote: Gladly Administrators can set API permissions on an agent-by-agent basis.
To create and use an API token, your user must have the API User permission.

access.why: Tokens require an existing Gladly tenant where an administrator grants the API User permission; no self-serve signup or public pricing seen.

evidence.quote: Your sandbox environment is accessible at https://{organization}.gladly.qa, where organization is your company name.

buildability.main_blocker.why: API is documented with a sandbox, but needs a customer tenant and admin grant; plan/price gating is not stated, so no listed blocker fits exactly.

mcp.exists.why: Only a third-party StackOne MCP was seen; no official Gladly MCP verified.

access_notes: Requires a Gladly customer account; an administrator grants API User permission, then user creates API token. Sandbox at {organization}.gladly.qa.
